[[File:TractorBeamProjector-NEGWT.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[Q7 tractor beam projector/Legends|Q7 tractor beam projector]]]]
A '''tractor beam projector''', '''tractor beam generator''', or '''emitter tower'''<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a device capable of generating a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]].

==Design==
A tractor beam projector was a large piece of equipment that was manned by a crew of up to ten operators and [[Technician/Legends|technicians]]. The units were maintenance-intensive and commonly found on large [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] such as [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] and [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]]. Tractor beam equipment was too large to be installed aboard [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
During the [[New Sith Wars]], some cultures constructed projector devices as small as a hand-held wand. In later ages, such as the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], such technologies had been forgotten.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

One such projector was used in the pressurized [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of the ''[[Sun Runner]]'' [[False Sun Runner|counterfeit ship]] fabricated in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] for his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-foiled attempt to destroy the orbital [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]]. The [[Phylon Transport/Legends|Phylon Transport]] projector's inescapable tractor beam drew in not only a [[Nallastian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and a [[Fondor Space Patrol]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]], but also a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] piloted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The projector was destroyed by Kenobi's [[Anakin Skywalker's first lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], enabling not only the three ships' escape through a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]-concealed docking port exit, but also the Skywalker-initiated [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton-grenade]] destruction of the false ''Sun Runner ''itself.<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>
